aspect: It is priced to be paid
description: The demand is set below the value of the time and risk of refusing. That is what makes it sustainable and what makes it universal.
energy_note: Cheaper to pay than to argue, every time, by design.

description: A vehicle search, a manufactured infraction, a trip to the station, a day gone. The escalation path is known to everyone, which is why it rarely has to be used.
energy_note: Standing on principle costs you a working day.

aspect: Young men and visible earners are targeted
description: A laptop, a good phone, dreadlocks, a nice car. Markers of a young person doing well function as selection criteria, which is the SARS pattern in POL-002 in its everyday form.

Four stops between Ikeja and the terminal. Two hundred naira, two hundred, one hundred, and one who waves them through. She has budgeted for this. Her visiting cousin from Manchester has not, and argues at the second one, and they miss check-in by nine minutes.
energy_note: A flight missed by someone who did not know the tariff.
